visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a 2D animation style. A blue, six-legged creature known as Bugcat Capoo is lying on a plain white ground next to a dark mouse hole. A small yellow triangular piece of cheese sits on the ground. A grey mouse with large ears pops out of the hole, grabs the cheese, and retreats. Capoo watches with a neutral expression. (2) Capoo's body turns a dark teal color with red glowing eyes and dark wavy lines emanating from its back, signaling intense anger. The background transitions to a bright yellow space where Capoo, now blue again, is seen hugging the grey mouse. Beside them is a massive pile of yellow cheese rounds, slices, and crackers. Capoo has a wide, happy mouth and closed eyes. (3) The scene shifts slightly to show many identical grey mice crawling all over the large cheese pile. Capoo looks at a specific cheese wheel with a hole in it where a mouse is peeking out. Capoo's eyes sparkle with excitement, indicated by white diamond shapes in the eyes. (4) Capoo opens its mouth extremely wide, revealing a dark red interior with vertical lines. The creature proceeds to swallow the entire pile of cheese along with all the mice. The scene cuts to Capoo looking satisfied with a small heart appearing above its head. (5) A girl with red hair is seen sleeping in a bed under a white blanket. Capoo approaches the bed and pulls back the blanket. When the girl wakes up, Capoo opens its mouth to show the three mice inside. The girl's face turns red with a jagged mouth as she screams. An external shot of a small white house on a green hill shows the house vibrating before exploding. Finally, Capoo is seen sitting on the grass crying with a large red bump on its head.
